d: We are seeking an experienced, organized, and service-oriented Management Services Manager to oversee corporate management services, administrative operations, and organizational support functions.

The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient delivery of management services, coordinating corporate activities, streamlining administrative processes, and providing effective support to senior management and business functions. The successful candidate will play a key role in improving service quality, strengthening internal coordination, optimizing resources, and ensuring smooth day-to-day corporate operations.
Lead and oversee management services and corporate administrative support activities across the organization.
Ensure effective delivery of administrative services, facilities management, office management, and general support functions.
Coordinate with departmental heads to understand management requirements and ensure timely delivery of support services.
Develop, implement, and monitor policies, procedures, and service standards for management services.
Manage corporate facilities, office infrastructure, utilities, maintenance, and workplace services.
Oversee vendor and service provider relationships, ensuring service quality, cost efficiency, and compliance with agreed contracts.
Monitor administrative budgets, control operational expenses, and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate corporate meetings, management reviews, official events, and other organizational activities.
Ensure effective management of office resources, assets, equipment, and administrative records.
Establish service delivery KPIs and monitor performance to ensure continuous improvement.
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements to enhance service quality and productivity.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, health and safety requirements, and relevant regulatory standards.
Coordinate with HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, and other departments to ensure seamless delivery of corporate services.
Prepare periodic management reports, budget updates, and service performance reviews for senior management.
Lead and develop the management services team, ensuring accountability, service excellence, and operational efficiency.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Public Administration, or a related discipline.
MBA or professional certification in Facilities Management, Administration, or Operations Management will be an advantage.
5–8 years of relevant experience in management services, corporate administration, facilities management, or corporate operations.
Proven experience managing administrative services, facilities, vendors, budgets, and support teams.
Strong understanding of corporate policies, administrative procedures, procurement coordination, and service delivery management.
Experience in budgeting, cost control, resource optimization, and performance monitoring.
Proficiency in MS Office applications; knowledge of ERP and facilities management systems will be preferred.
Excellent organizational, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

Our team consists of 25,000 colleagues, spread across 35 countries. We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.
We offer career opportunities for relationship managers, customer service specialists, product and segment management, sales and wealth planning.
If you’re looking to unlock new job growth opportunities, Standard Chartered Bank is the place for you. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 11 million clients in many of the world’s fastest-growing markets. Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.

Analyse data to identify opportunities and threats.
Develop a clear product vision that aligns with the bank's overall strategy and goals.
Create and maintain a product roadmap that outlines the key features, timelines, and milestones.
Communicate product strategy, progress, and changes effectively to all stakeholders.
Drive new business and strategic initiatives across different business segments within Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB)
Business owner in all related product platform
Drive platform usage, client penetration efforts.
Accountable for delivery of all product enhancements, project deliveries in terms of championing as business lead
Manage operations, IT and middle office resources indirectly in terms of driving changes, delivery and strategy.
Responsible for overseeing end to end product process through the product life cycle, including all risk management initiatives.
Owns and responsible for Country Product Programme/Addendum and ensure alignment to the Group Product Programme
Ensure compliance to internal and external governance standards and regulatory requirements.
Participate in audits, manage regulatory incidents and communications on product and drive the process, product and system changes to minimise regulatory breaches.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
